events.details: Jerrell Wright reportedly stopped attending day support because he disagreed with restrictions on bringing his computer, iPad or other devices.
Jerrell Wright reportedly resumed attending day support.

At approximately 11:20 p.m., Jerrell Wright and Steven (Steve) reportedly had a physical altercation following a disagreement involving a girlfriend. They threw water bottles at each other, and Jerrell Wright reportedly threw a water bottle at Steven (Steve). A 911 call was made and police responded.
At approximately 5:30 p.m., Jerrell Wright reportedly insisted on shopping, left the group home despite staff direction, and staff brought him back.

At approximately 4:30 p.m., Jerrell Wright reportedly returned from day support, was described as aggressive, went outside despite staff direction, was brought back by staff, called 911, and said he did not belong there.
Jerrell Wright stopped attending day support for a reportedly behavior-related reason. The exact reason and circumstances are not known.
